title: Velvety Umami Dutch Fish Stew
description: A rich, velvety Dutch-inspired fish stew with a deep umami flavor, featuring lime leaves and served in a dolsot stone bowl.
instructions: Heat the binchotan charcoal in a small skillet over medium heat, stirring frequently.
Add the butter to the skillet and melt, then add the minced ginger and cook for 1 minute.
Add the kaffir lime leaves and cook for an additional 1 minute, stirring frequently.
Add the mussels to the skillet and cook until they start to open, about 2-3 minutes.
Add the cod fillets to the skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Add the fish stock, Dutch mustard, and white wine to the skillet, stirring to combine.
Simmer the stew for 5-7 minutes, or until the flavors have melded together and the mussels are fully open.
Serve the stew in a dolsot stone bowl, garnished with additional lime leaves and a sprinkle of binchotan charcoal.
